Title: Highfield Therapy
Welcome: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. My name is Robert.
About: My name is Robert, and I provide professional therapy services to help you navigate life's challenges. I am committed to attending regular training and CPD, and to learning more about how I can help people.
Therapy: I am a humanistic therapist with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA). I offer online counselling, and I also offer counselling from home in a private garden room where you can talk openly about your concerns. Online or face-to-face sessions are available.
Fees: Sessions are £50, and I offer concessions to those on a low or no income. I can arrange a free 15-minute phone consultation to talk about how I can help and answer any questions you may have about therapy, then book an in-person or online appointment.
Contact: I'm based in Sheffield, a 20-minute walk from Sheffield Central station and close to a tram stop, with plenty of free on-street parking. To get in touch, call or message 07946827431, or use the email button below.
